table.note: no table: no column was matched to a sample; agent: The workbooks hold integer per-gene columns named A01_count to A03_count, D01_count to D03_count and F01_count to F03_count, next to separate TPM columns, so they are raw read counts. No sample is given in sources because the column names (A01, D01, F01 and so on) do not match the GEO sample titles (CTRL, BLEO, BLEODMY) or accessions, and the file letters are not tied to a condition (A and D both say Control_vs_Bleo), so no column can be assigned to a sample.
